QuickShare moves files directly between devices on the same Wi-Fi network. Nothing is uploaded anywhere, and no account is needed.

Files are streamed in small chunks, so a multi-gigabyte video transfers without ever being loaded into memory. Every completed transfer is verified with a SHA-256 checksum and written only inside the folder you choose.
QuickShare asks only for network and notification permissions. It does not request location, contacts, or full storage access.

Step-by-step guide to sending and receiving
The other device will ask to confirm this code before anything is sent.
That QR code is not a QuickShare pairing code.
QuickShare sends files straight from one device to another over Wi-Fi. No internet, no account, no cloud.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network. No router? Turn on the hotspot on one phone and join it from the other.
On the device that will receive, keep “Receive files” switched on (first tab).
On the Nearby tab, wait for the other device to appear in the list.
Tap the device you want to send to.
Tap “Choose files” and pick one or more files. You can add more or remove some before sending.
Tap “Send”. A pairing code is shown on your screen.
Watch the progress bar. You can cancel at any time, and a failed transfer can be retried from the History tab.
Keep “Receive files” switched on. Your device is now visible to nearby devices.
When someone sends to you, check that the pairing code on your screen matches the one on theirs, then tap Accept.
Review the list of files and the total size, then accept the transfer.
Received files are saved in a QuickShare folder inside the folder you chose in Settings. The first time, you will be asked to pick one.
Tap Refresh, and check both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network with QuickShare open.
Use “Show my QR code” on one device and “Scan QR code” on the other.
Or choose “Connect by IP address” and type the other device\'s address, for example 192.168.1.42.
Every finished transfer is checked with a SHA-256 checksum, so you know the file arrived intact.
The History tab shows what was sent and received, and whether each file was verified.
Large files are fine. Keep the devices close to the router and avoid locking the screen during very long transfers.
QuickShare is designed and built by Cluster_Lab: fast, private file sharing between your own devices, with no accounts and no cloud.
